access_note: Commercial licence; request a quote or evaluation from Remcom.
description: Wireless InSite is commercial 3D wireless prediction software from Remcom that provides a suite of radio propagation models for site-specific analysis of radio-wave propagation and wireless communication systems: full 3D ray tracing with the X3D model, fast ray-based methods and empirical models. It handles urban, indoor, rural and terrain scenes built from building footprints, terrain, foliage and material properties, and predicts path loss, received power, delay and angular spread, and MIMO and beamforming behaviour for 5G and millimetre-wave systems, including targeted ray casting for specific links. Remcom, a US electromagnetic simulation company that also makes XFdtd and XGtd, develops it for network planners, device designers and researchers. Coverage: any location for which the user supplies geometry, from a single room to city districts, at resolutions set by the scene and ray settings. Format and access: licensed Windows and Linux desktop software with a GUI and scripting, with GPU acceleration; paid, with prices and evaluation licences on request. Caveats: results depend on the quality of 3D building and material data; large scenes are computationally heavy; proprietary models limit independent verification. Simulation uses: coverage and hazard exposure analysis of mobile networks, capacity planning of 5G small cells, and radio digital twins of cities or critical facilities. Related records: Sionna and NVIDIA Aerial Omniverse Digital Twin are GPU ray-tracing alternatives, and Atoll and Planet are network planning suites that can import such predictions.
